usedFor: actiTIME holds customers, projects and tasks, and a “Task Created” event there can hand text to “Humanize Text” in Hastewire.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Created” in actiTIME, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: A new task in actiTIME can be followed by text made to sound natural in Hastewire.

watchOut: “Task Updated” and “Project Updated” fire on every edit, so the same record can reach “Humanize Text” more than once.
